coefficient_format: per block and channel 4 words, 3 fields of 10 bits each (bit 9 sign, bits 8..0 magnitude), c0..c11 in field order; gain(u,v) = c11/128 + (c9*u + c10*v)/256 + (c0*u^3*v + c1*u*v^3 + c2*u^3 + c3*u^2*v + c4*u*v^2 + c5*v^3 + c6*u^2 + c7*u*v + c8*v^2)/512, u and v in [0,1] across the block
